title: Prospective cross-sectional attention and next-day return
claim: Abnormal attention rank predicts next-day relative returns within the weekly point-in-time Hyperliquid top ten after costs.
mechanism: Gradual diffusion of retail attention creates temporary cross-sectional demand pressure.
target: Next-day relative Hyperliquid return and top-minus-bottom costed portfolio
primaryBaseline: Registered market controls and flat relative-value portfolio
nextAction: Complete universe and execution readiness before starting D0; do not treat the fixed-panel retrospective diagnostic as confirmation.
